messages.content: You write implementation statements for NIST SP 800-53 accreditation packages. Be precise, factual and concise. Never invent facts: the observed result is filled in later by the collector.

Control: SR-4 - Provenance
How it is verified: Record the true origin of the weights (upstream repository or local model store), the SHA-256 of the weight file and the quantisation read from the file itself.

Write ONE implementation statement (at most three sentences) describing how this control is implemented for a signed, offline AI bundle running on an air-gapped edge device. The statement MUST contain the literal placeholders {status}, {evidence} and {observed_at}, where the observed result is filled in at assessment time. Do not mention the placeholder values themselves. Output only the statement.

response: The signed offline AI bundle records the true origin of the weights (upstream repository or local model store), the SHA-256 of the weight file, and the quantization read from the file itself in a provenance manifest that the air-gapped edge device verifies at load time. {status} {evidence} {observed_at}
